cases.U8-01: Local paid correction changes its target only; origin, other bindings, renewed residual recurrence and carrier displacement survive.
cases.U8-02: Temporary approval support enables response without independent mastery; two distinct observed independent practices are required for reusable guarded capacity.
cases.U8-03: Retained capacity works on unfamiliar targets and changed partners after withdrawal at the same or greater simultaneous demand; independent later return permits reownership.
cases.U8-04: Separate factual accuracy, useful performance, pathway, and retained access; rest, forgetting, incomplete work and a single endpoint do not establish clearance.
cases.U8-05: Raw accounting/provenance, hidden state isolation, replay, partial continuation, forged evidence and protected regressions.

construction: Deterministic finite development panel. U14 reserved cases and R21C are not used.
representation: Paid local bindings; observed practice episodes; learned scope keyed to actor/pattern/context/cue/trigger; capacity load supported by at least two independent batches; original material preserved through versioned treatment.
capacity_rule: At least two distinct independently executed, observed and retained successful batches, at least two distinct target identities. Maximum load is the greatest batch size supported by two episodes. Current processed safety/availability/consent/actual-requirement checks always apply. No universal action or semantic capacity.
correction_scope: Only generated or injected approval/obligation effects have an evidence-supported release operator in U8; other U7 effects remain residual/unassessed.
path_checks: actual material use in separate U6 witness
claim_boundary: Only enumerated finite returns. No proof that returns respect identity equivalence; arbitrary composite closure remains unassessed.
regression: All U2-U7 tests and raw witnesses plus U7 legacy panel; original 3044 baseline members remain byte-identical.
